About these terms

Our products

  • Multi-brand retailer: we sell fragrances from different brands. Brand names, logos and product photographs belong to their owners. Unless we say so, we are not an authorised dealer of, or affiliated with, those brands.
  • Full bottles are supplied in the condition stated on the product page.
  • Decants are a smaller amount of fragrance that we transfer from an original bottle into a separate atomiser. Product photographs show the original bottle for reference, not the decant packaging.
  • Fragrance notes describe the scent's character, not an ingredient list. How a fragrance smells and lasts varies with skin, application and conditions. Families and occasion pairings are suggestions.
  • Safety: perfume is flammable. Keep it away from heat, flames, eyes and children. Test on a small area of skin if you have sensitive skin or allergies.

Prices and availability

Prices are shown in Indian rupees (INR). Delivery charges are shown at checkout before you pay, and there is no added payment fee. Checkout rechecks price and stock before payment. If an item becomes unavailable or was listed at an obvious pricing error, we may cancel the order and refund you in full.

Listings marked as community offers or enquiries are dated quotes for information only. They are not an offer to sell until we confirm price, stock and terms with you directly.

Orders and payment

  • Your order is confirmed only after your payment is verified.
  • Razorpay: the order is confirmed once Razorpay confirms a successful payment of the full amount.
  • Direct UPI: pay the exact order total to the UPI ID shown at checkout and enter your UPI transaction reference (UTR). We confirm the order once we have matched the payment. Stock is held for 30 minutes; orders not paid in that time are released.
  • If a payment reaches us after an order has been released, we will contact you to fulfil the order if stock allows, or refund the payment in full.

Accounts

You can check out as a guest or sign in. If you sign in, keep access to your email or Google account secure. Your private order tracking link lets anyone who has it see the order status, so share it with care.

To the extent permitted by law, our total liability for any order is limited to the amount you paid for it. Nothing in these terms limits your rights under applicable consumer protection law.
